scenario.name: emergency
scenario.title: Emergency vehicle priority
scenario.description: Ten ambulances and fire trucks cross the corridor during rush hour from every side: both ways along the arterial, along each cross street, and with turns. Signals give them a green path; we measure their travel time and the extra delay for everyone else.
scenario.question: How many seconds does signal preemption save an emergency vehicle, and what does it cost other traffic?

controller.name: fixed_time
controller.label: Fixed-time (90 s)
controller.description: Same timing every 90 s cycle, 50/50 split, no coordination. Our starting point.
